================================================================================
Literal keyword preserves a longer word at zero precedence
:cst
================================================================================
literal:matchbox
---
0:0  - 0:16   program
0:0  - 0:16     literal
0:0  - 0:8        "literal:"
0:8  - 0:16       word `matchbox`

Fixed regex preserves a longer word at zero precedence

================================================================================

0:0  - 0:6        "regex:"
0:6  - 0:14       word `matchbox`

================================================================================
Literal keyword followed by a separate word at zero precedence
================================================================================
literal:match box
---
(program (literal (literal_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Fixed regex followed by a separate word at zero precedence
================================================================================
regex:match box
---
(program (fixed_regex (regex_statement (word))))

================================================================================
Singleton class followed by a separate word at zero precedence
================================================================================
class:match box
---
(program (singleton_class (class_statement (word))))

================================================================================

================================================================================

---

================================================================================
Exact repetition followed by a separate word at zero precedence
================================================================================
repeat:match box
---
(program (exact_repeat (repeat_statement (word))))
